criteria.note: Precise, testable candidate contract with rule IDs enforced and fault-injected in the model; not reviewed (independent_reviewer + ADR needed).

criteria.criterion: loop/reflection-suppression model with at least two simulated bridges and fidelity-loss signaling
criteria.note: Exhaustive interleaving exploration of B1 (Matrix-like) + B2 (XMPP-like) + optional OM-unaware foreign relay (absent/preserving/stripping): termination, typed authorship, ForeignProvenance, identity links, E2EE-boundary disclosure, fidelity flags against an oracle, target mapping and reflection suppression hold; 8 fault injections each caught. Residual: a metadata-stripping foreign relay yields bounded, flagged reflections. Reviewer sign-off on the model is still required by the phase's independence rule.

criteria.criterion: real adapters and multi-bridge traces meet the model (pre-release)

independence: Contract and Rust explorer written by a Claude agent from INTEROPERABILITY_BRIDGES_AND_FOREIGN_PROVENANCE.md and TRANSPORT_ADAPTERS_AND_INTEROP.md (different language and author from verification/bounded/wire_boundary_models.py). The design package was authored by a ChatGPT design agent and Claude agents; ADR-0117 (proposed) decides whether an AI reviewer counts as independent. The pre-engineering phase requires independent_reviewer sign-off, which does not exist.

bridges: B1: OM<->M (Matrix-like: rich, edits, reactions, metadata)
B2: OM<->X (XMPP-like: plain text, no edits, no reactions, metadata extension)
F: OM-unaware M<->X bridge (absent | preserve | strip metadata)

scenarios.description: OM rich message + edit + reaction through B1 (Matrix-like) and B2 (XMPP-like)
foreign messages from M and X, one impersonating 'Alice', one with a verified identity link
OM message loops OM->M->F->X->OM and OM->X->F->M->OM; F keeps interop metadata
one foreign event reaches the Room via B1 directly and via F+B2
RESIDUAL: F strips metadata; reflections are bounded and flagged origin_unverified, not suppressed
RESIDUAL: a foreign event relayed by a metadata-stripping F reaches the Room twice, both flagged origin_unverified
B2 removed while an OM message and a foreign reply are in flight; B2 re-admitted later
reaction/edit to a message that was never exported (sent before B2 admission) and foreign reply to an unknown target
BAC-OUT-3 disabled + trace-stripping F: infinite echo
BAC-FP-1 violated (bridge-scoped fingerprint): duplicate import via two bridges
BAC-IN-1/3 disabled: reflections of OM-origin messages
BAC-IN-2 disabled on a network that drops metadata on echo
BAC-OUT-1 disabled: retroactive export of pre-admission history
